role: Quantify how heterogeneous species-level information changes the sampling spread of an across-species mean under a true-zero spatial-colour association. This cannot retest or rescue H6/H6b.

source_frame.target_species_rule: exact completed H6b sparse n>=5 photos, >=3 occupied H1 cells, >=2 morph levels frame
source_frame.reliable_species_rule: exact completed H6/H6b n>=10 photos, >=5 occupied H1 cells, >=2 morph levels frame
source_frame.species_information: cell-pair count from the outcome-blind spatial sampling geometry and the species-specific empirical sampling variance of rho from the exact H6b within-species photo-level colour permutation null

empirical_sampling_distributions.per_species_null_recomputation: reuse exact H6b prepare_species_photo_null for every one of the 188 fixed target species
empirical_sampling_distributions.species_null_variance: sample variance ddof=1 across that species' 999 null rho values
empirical_sampling_distributions.zero_center_rule: subtract each species' own mean across its 999 H6b null rho values before resampling; this enforces the S4 true-mean-zero condition without changing its marginal heteroskedasticity or non-Gaussian shape

simulation.draw_rule: for every replicate and every species, independently sample one value with replacement from that species' 999 zero-centered empirical H6b null rho values
simulation.cross_species_dependence: none imposed; the target is information heterogeneity rather than environmental or taxonomic covariance

estimators.weights: fixed cell_pairs divided by total cell_pairs across the 188 target species
1/species_null_variance normalized to sum 1; no floor or truncation unless a zero/nonfinite variance makes the simulation not evaluable
1/74 for the fixed reliable H6 primary frame only

claim_ceiling: May show that equal-species aggregation is more or less noisy than geometry/information-weighted alternatives under the completed H6b sampling structure. It cannot establish a biological mean effect, invalidate equal weighting generally, or change any completed H6/H6b support decision.
